description: M1 standalone demo corpus (MEMBER_1.md section 3): a small controlled set of REAL authoritative-source excerpts with real metadata, used only for independent development, testing and controlled demo fallback. At integration this corpus becomes the fallback/demo path, not the production knowledge source for India/ABS/International queries. Every excerpt marked verbatim=false is a curated paraphrase from the team research dossier (Research.md) against the cited authoritative source; consult the URL for the authoritative text. Entries may carry text_hi: a Hindi rendering of the same curated excerpt for supported MVP scenarios — the authoritative text remains the English original at the cited source.

entries.title: Traditional knowledge excluded from patentability
entries.text: Section 3 of the Patents Act, 1970 lists what are 'not inventions within the meaning of this Act'. Clause (p) excludes 'an invention which, in effect, is traditional knowledge or which is an aggregation or duplication of known properties of traditionally known component or components'. Classical Ayurvedic formulations documented in First-Schedule authoritative texts are in effect traditional knowledge and therefore face this patentability bar; defensive protection for such knowledge is maintained through the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL).
entries.text_hi: भारतीय पेटेंट अधिनियम, 1970 की धारा 3 वे कृत्य बताती है जो 'इस अधिनियम के अर्थ में आविष्कार नहीं' माने जाते हैं। खंड (p) के अंतर्गत 'वह आविष्कार जो प्रभाव में पारंपरिक ज्ञान है, या जो पारंपरिक रूप से ज्ञात घटक या घटकों के ज्ञात गुणों का समुच्चयन या प्रतिलिपि है', आविष्कार नहीं माना जाता। प्रथम अनुसूची के प्रामाणिक ग्रंथों में वर्णित शास्त्रीय आयुर्वेदिक योग (फॉर्मूलेशन) प्रभाव में पारंपरिक ज्ञान हैं, अतः उन पर यह पेटेंट-योग्यता बाधा लागू होती है; ऐसे ज्ञान का रक्षात्मक संरक्षण पारंपरिक ज्ञान डिजिटल लाइब्रेरी (TKDL) के माध्यम से होता है।
entries.provenance: Clause (p) wording quoted as recorded in the team research dossier (Research.md B.1.a); classical-formulation characterisation is a curated summary per Research.md B.1.a. Full act text on the official IP India e-version of the Patents Act, 1970.

entries.title: Disclosure of biological material source and geographical origin
entries.text: Section 10(4)(d) of the Patents Act, 1970 requires the complete specification of a patent application to disclose the geographical origin and source of biological material used in the invention. For Ayurvedic inventions that use plant or other biological resources, this disclosure obligation connects the patent application to India's Biological Diversity Act compliance requirements.
entries.text_hi: भारतीय पेटेंट अधिनियम, 1970 की धारा 10(4)(d) के अंतर्गत पेटेंट आवेदन के पूर्ण विवरण में आविष्कार में प्रयुक्त जैव सामग्री का भौगोलिक उत्पत्ति-स्थान और स्रोत प्रकट करना अनिवार्य है। पौधों या अन्य जैव संसाधनों का उपयोग करने वाले आयुर्वेदिक आविष्कारों के लिए यह प्रकटीकरण-दायित्व पेटेंट आवेदन को भारत के जैव विविधता अधिनियम के अनुपालन आवश्यकताओं से जोड़ता है।
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md B.1.a (Section 10(4)(d) disclosure requirement). Full act text on the official IP India e-version. text_hi is a Hindi rendering of the same excerpt.

entries.title: Updated examination procedures, fees and timelines for Indian patent applications
entries.text: The Patents (Amendment) Rules, 2024 were notified on 15 March 2024, updating examination procedures, fee structures and timelines for patent applications in India. Patent applications are filed with the Indian Patent Office under the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM), and a request for examination is made on Form 18 within 48 months of filing. Verify current forms and fees on the IP India website before filing.
entries.text_hi: पेटेंट (संशोधन) नियम, 2024 की अधिसूचना 15 मार्च 2024 को जारी हुई, जिसने भारत में पेटेंट आवेदनों की जाँच प्रक्रिया, शुल्क संरचना और समय-सीमाओं को अद्यतन किया। पेटेंट आवेदन भारतीय पेटेंट कार्यालय में, कंट्रोलर जनरल ऑफ़ पेटेंट्स, डिज़ाइन्स एंड ट्रेड मार्क्स (CGPDTM) के कार्यालय के अंतर्गत किए जाते हैं, और जाँच हेतु निवेदन फ़ॉर्म-18 पर फ़ाइलिंग के 48 महीनों के भीतर किया जाता है। फ़ाइल करने से पहले वर्तमान फ़ॉर्म और शुल्क IP India वेबसाइट पर अवश्य देख लें।
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md B.1.a (2024 Patents Rules notification date, Form 18 / 48-month examination request). Confirm the current fee schedule and forms on ipindia.gov.in.

entries.source_name: CGPDTM Guidelines for Processing Patent Applications of AYUSH Systems and Related Inventions
entries.title: AYUSH patent application processing guidelines
entries.text: The Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM) has issued guidelines for processing patent applications of AYUSH systems and related inventions (notified 23 September 2025, per the team research dossier). The guidelines mandate a TKDL prior-art search for AYUSH-related patent applications, require Biological Diversity Act compliance where biological resources are used, and apply the Section 3 patentability exclusions rigorously.
entries.text_hi: कंट्रोलर जनरल ऑफ़ पेटेंट्स, डिज़ाइन्स एंड ट्रेड मार्क्स (CGPDTM) ने आयुष पद्धतियों और संबंधित आविष्कारों के पेटेंट आवेदनों के प्रक्रमण हेतु दिशानिर्देश जारी किए हैं (टीम शोध-डोजियर के अनुसार 23 सितंबर 2025 को अधिसूचित)। ये दिशानिर्देश आयुष-संबंधी पेटेंट आवेदनों के लिए TKDL पूर्व-अनुसंधान खोज अनिवार्य करते हैं, जैव संसाधनों के उपयोग पर जैव विविधता अधिनियम के अनुपालन की माँग करते हैं, और धारा 3 की पेटेंट-योग्यता बहिष्कृतियों को कड़ाई से लागू करते हैं।
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md B.1.a / F (CGPDTM AYUSH guidelines, 23 September 2025, Source P). Verify the current guideline document on ipindia.gov.in before relying on details.

entries.title: TKDL pointer: what it is and how it is accessed
entries.text: The Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) is the Indian government database that documents codified traditional knowledge, including classical formulations from Ayurveda and other Indian systems, in a structure usable by patent examiners as defensive prior art. Its full text is restricted: access is limited to patent offices under non-disclosure agreements, so the assistant points to TKDL and describes what it covers rather than quoting its contents. Public information and access routes are described on the official TKDL portal at tkdl.res.in.
entries.text_hi: पारंपरिक ज्ञान डिजिटल लाइब्रेरी (TKDL) भारत सरकार का डेटाबेस है जो संहिताबद्ध पारंपरिक ज्ञान — जिसमें आयुर्वेद सहित भारतीय पद्धतियों के शास्त्रीय योग शामिल हैं — को पेटेंट परीक्षकों के लिए रक्षात्मक पूर्व-अनुसंधान (prior art) के रूप में उपयोग योग्य संरचना में दस्तावेजित करता है। इसका पूर्ण पाठ प्रतिबंधित है: पहुँच गोपनीयता समझौतों (NDA) के अंतर्गत केवल पेटेंट कार्यालयों को है, इसलिए सहायक TKDL की ओर संकेत करता है और बताता है कि वह क्या कवर करता है — उसकी सामग्री उद्धृत नहीं करता। सार्वजनिक जानकारी और पहुँच के तरीके आधिकारिक TKDL पोर्टल tkdl.res.in पर वर्णित हैं।
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md D.1 and MEMBER_1.md/Plan.md TKDL-handling rules: TKDL full text is NDA-restricted to patent offices, so this entry is a pointer, never a quotation of TKDL contents. Host tkdl.res.in as given in the SIH problem statement.

entries.title: Single international patent application route
entries.text: The Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), administered by WIPO, is the international patent filing route: a single international patent application can seek patent protection for an invention across 150+ PCT contracting states. India is a PCT member; Indian applicants can file via the Indian Patent Office as receiving office (RO/IN) or directly with the WIPO International Bureau (RO/IB) using ePCT. National-phase entry in chosen states is due 30/31 months from the priority date, and an International Search Report helps assess prior art early.
entries.text_hi: पेटेंट सहयोग संधि (PCT), जिसका प्रशासन WIPO करती है, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पेटेंट फ़ाइलिंग का मार्ग है: एक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पेटेंट आवेदन से 150+ PCT सदस्य राज्यों में आविष्कार के लिए पेटेंट सुरक्षा माँगी जा सकती है। भारत PCT सदस्य है; भारतीय आवेदक भारतीय पेटेंट कार्यालय को रिसीविंग ऑफ़िस (RO/IN) मानकर, या सीधे WIPO अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ब्यूरो (RO/IB) को ePCT के माध्यम से आवेदन कर सकते हैं। चुने गए राज्यों में राष्ट्रीय-चरण प्रवेश प्राथमिकता तिथि से 30/31 महीनों के भीतर करना होता है, और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय खोज रिपोर्ट पूर्व-अनुसंधान का शीघ्र मूल्यांकन कराती है।
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md C.4 and the official WIPO PCT page (URL verified live, September 2026). India's PCT membership stated in Research.md C.4.

entries.title: TRIPS flexibility to exclude plants, animals and essentially biological processes
entries.text: Article 27.3(b) of the TRIPS Agreement allows WTO Members to exclude from patentability plants and animals other than micro-organisms, and essentially biological processes for the production of plants or animals other than non-biological and microbiological processes. Members must, however, provide for the protection of plant varieties either by patents or by an effective sui generis system or by any combination thereof. India uses these TRIPS flexibilities alongside its domestic traditional-knowledge exclusions.
entries.provenance: Curated summary of Article 27.3(b) per the official WTO legal text (URL verified live, September 2026). TRIPS entered into force 1 January 1995.

entries.title: International trade mark registration (trade marks only — not patents)
entries.text: The Madrid System, administered by WIPO, is the international registration system for TRADE MARKS: a single international trade mark application can cover more than 130 members. India joined the Madrid Protocol in 2013. The Madrid System registers trade marks only — it is not a route for patents or industrial designs.
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md C.5 and the official WIPO Madrid page (URL verified live, September 2026).

entries.source_name: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (GRATK)
entries.title: Patent disclosure obligation for genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge
entries.text: The WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (GRATK) was adopted on 24 May 2024. Once in force, it will require patent applicants whose claimed inventions are based on genetic resources and/or associated traditional knowledge to disclose the country of origin of the genetic resources and/or the Indigenous Peoples or local community providing the associated traditional knowledge, or declare that these are unknown. Entry into force requires 15 ratifications; per the corpus reference date (August 2026) it was not yet in force — verify the current status on the WIPO treaty page.
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md C.3 and the official WIPO GRATK treaty page (URL verified live, September 2026). In-force status is time-sensitive and flagged for re-verification.

entries.source_name: Hague System (Hague Agreement, Geneva Act) — WIPO
entries.title: International industrial design registration (designs only — not patents)
entries.text: The Hague System, administered by WIPO, is the international registration system for industrial DESIGNs: a single international application can register up to 100 designs in many member territories. India acceded to the Geneva Act of the Hague Agreement in 2018. The Hague System protects designs (such as packaging, bottle shapes and label layouts) — it is not a route for patents or trade marks.
entries.provenance: Curated summary per Research.md C.6 and the official WIPO Hague page (URL verified live, September 2026).
